justification: The package contains 15 production classes in `javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javassistmodel/` totaling about 2.2k LOC: `JavassistClassDeclaration.java`, `JavassistInterfaceDeclaration.java`, `JavassistEnumDeclaration.java`, `JavassistRecordDeclaration.java`, `JavassistAnnotationDeclaration.java`, `JavassistMethodDeclaration.java`, `JavassistConstructorDeclaration.java`, `JavassistFieldDeclaration.java`, `JavassistParameterDeclaration.java`, `JavassistTypeParameter.java`, `JavassistEnumConstantDeclaration.java`, `JavassistAnnotationMemberDeclaration.java`, `JavassistFactory.java`, `JavassistUtils.java`, and the two adapters. These classes cover many responsibilities at once: type-declaration wrappers for class/interface/enum/annotation/record, member wrappers, type conversion, and method/symbol resolution. The package centralizes all Javassist-backed symbol-solver logic, which is strong evidence of a God Component.
